package standard

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/agentic-kit/foundations/knowledge/catalog"
	catalogkit "github.com/geoffmilleraz/agentic-kit/kits/catalog-kit"
	"__REVIEW_MODULE__/internal/core"
)

type pilotReviewSidecar struct {
	Kind       DefinitionKind
	Source     DefinitionSource
	Origin     CatalogOrigin
	Definition any
	Layers     []string
}

// Hex is injective over UTF-8 bytes and stays stable across insertions/order.
func pilotReviewSlug(key string) string { return "k" + hex.EncodeToString([]byte(key)) }

// The sidecar stays in Review Kit's stable-key space. Only discoverable
// metadata enters the common catalog; typed definitions remain authoritative.
func pilotReviewProjection(layers []Layer) (catalogkit.Bundle, map[string]pilotReviewSidecar, error) {
	byKey := map[string]pilotReviewSidecar{}
	common := make([]catalogkit.Layer, 0, len(layers))
	for _, layer := range layers {
		roots := []catalog.AuthoredNode{{Slug: "review", Title: "Review definitions", StableKey: "review-root", Source: "review-kit"}}
		var children []catalog.AuthoredNode
		definitions := map[string]struct {
			kind  DefinitionKind
			value any
		}{}
		for id, value := range layer.Std.Concepts {
			definitions[id] = struct {
				kind  DefinitionKind
				value any
			}{DefinitionConcept, value}
		}
		for id, value := range layer.Std.Requirements {
			definitions[id] = struct {
				kind  DefinitionKind
				value any
			}{DefinitionRequirement, value}
		}
		for id, value := range layer.Std.Findings {
			definitions[id] = struct {
				kind  DefinitionKind
				value any
			}{DefinitionFinding, value}
		}
		ids := make([]string, 0, len(definitions))
		for id := range definitions {
			ids = append(ids, id)
		}
		sort.Strings(ids)
		for _, id := range ids {
			value := definitions[id]
			source, ok := layer.Definitions[id]
			if !ok {
				return catalogkit.Bundle{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("missing authored source for %s", id)
			}
			side := pilotReviewSidecar{Kind: value.kind, Source: source, Origin: layer.Origin, Definition: value.value}
			if prior, exists := byKey[id]; exists {
				if prior.Kind != side.Kind {
					return catalogkit.Bundle{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("kind changed for %s", id)
				}
				side.Layers = append(side.Layers, prior.Layers...)
			}
			side.Layers = append(side.Layers, layer.Name)
			byKey[id] = side
			children = append(children, catalog.AuthoredNode{
				Slug: pilotReviewSlug(id), Title: id,
				StableKey: id, Source: source.Path, Extractor: "review-kit",
				Facets: map[string][]string{"kind": {string(value.kind)}},
			})
		}
		roots[0].Children = children
		commonLayer := catalogkit.Layer{Name: layer.Name, Nodes: roots}
		if len(common) > 0 {
			commonLayer.Requires = []string{common[len(common)-1].Name}
		}
		common = append(common, commonLayer)
	}
	returnBundle, err := catalogkit.Resolve(catalogkit.Spec{Version: 1, Layers: common}, catalogkit.Policy{})
	return returnBundle, byKey, err
}

func TestCatalogKitPilotReviewIdentityAndProvenance(t *testing.T) {
	root, err := filepath.Abs(filepath.Join("..", "..", "..", ".."))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	dir := filepath.Join(root, "__REVIEW_PATH__/internal/standard/testdata/standard-fixture")
	loaded, loadedSources, err := LoadStandardWithSources(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// The second layer is authored CUE and adds a distinct domain definition.
	// It lives only in the archived replay tree, never in the consumer checkout.
	overlayDir, err := os.MkdirTemp(root, ".catalog-pilot-overlay-")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { os.RemoveAll(overlayDir) })
	overlayCUE := []byte("package reviewkit\nstandard: #Standard & {\n version: \"1.0.1\"\n concepts: {\"pilot.added\": {title: \"Pilot layer addition\"}}\n}\n")
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(overlayDir, "standard.cue"), overlayCUE, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	overlay, overlaySources, err := LoadStandardWithSources(overlayDir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	layers, err := FlattenCatalogs(core.ProjectConfig{Catalogs: []core.CatalogSource{{Name: "local", Dir: dir}, {Name: "team", Dir: overlayDir, Extends: []string{"local"}}}}, root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(layers) != 2 || !reflect.DeepEqual(layers[0].Std, loaded) || !reflect.DeepEqual(layers[1].Std, overlay) {
		t.Fatal("FlattenCatalogs changed loaded typed definitions")
	}
	effective, err := BuildStandard(layers)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bundle, sidecars, err := pilotReviewProjection(layers)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := catalogkit.VerifyBundle(bundle); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(bundle.Order, []string{"local", "team"}) {
		t.Fatalf("common precedence: %v", bundle.Order)
	}
	want := map[string]any{}
	for id, v := range effective.Concepts {
		want[id] = v
	}
	for id, v := range effective.Requirements {
		want[id] = v
	}
	for id, v := range effective.Findings {
		want[id] = v
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(effective.Concepts["pilot.added"], overlay.Concepts["pilot.added"]) {
		t.Fatal("domain addition missing from effective standard")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, row := range catalogkit.Rows(bundle) {
		if row.StableKey == "review-root" {
			continue
		}
		definition, ok := want[row.StableKey]
		if !ok || seen[row.StableKey] {
			t.Fatalf("extra or duplicate stable key %q", row.StableKey)
		}
		seen[row.StableKey] = true
		side, ok := sidecars[row.StableKey]
		// BuildStandard computes the effective exception intersection after
		// choosing a requirement. The sidecar retains the authored definition.
		if effectiveReq, isRequirement := definition.(core.Requirement); isRequirement && ok {
			authoredReq := side.Definition.(core.Requirement)
			effectiveReq.Exceptions = authoredReq.Exceptions
			definition = effectiveReq
		}
		if !ok || !reflect.DeepEqual(side.Definition, definition) {
			t.Fatalf("typed definition lost at %q", row.StableKey)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(row.Layers, effective.ProvenanceChain[row.StableKey]) || !reflect.DeepEqual(side.Layers, row.Layers) {
			t.Fatalf("precedence mismatch for %q: common=%v domain=%v", row.StableKey, row.Layers, effective.ProvenanceChain[row.StableKey])
		}
		winner := 0
		loadedSource := loadedSources[row.StableKey]
		if row.StableKey == "pilot.added" {
			winner, loadedSource = 1, overlaySources[row.StableKey]
		}
		if effective.Provenance[row.StableKey] != layers[winner].Name {
			t.Fatalf("domain winner mismatch for %q", row.StableKey)
		}
		original := layers[winner].Definitions[row.StableKey]
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(side.Source, original) || side.Origin != layers[winner].Origin || row.Source != original.Path || original.Kind != loadedSource.Kind || original.StartLine != loadedSource.StartLine || original.EndLine != loadedSource.EndLine || original.ContentHash != loadedSource.ContentHash {
			t.Fatalf("source/origin lost for %q: %+v", row.StableKey, side)
		}
		if original.StartLine < 1 || original.EndLine < original.StartLine || original.ContentHash == "" || side.Origin.SourceKind != "local" {
			t.Fatalf("incomplete provenance for %q: %+v", row.StableKey, side)
		}
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, original.LocalPath))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		h := sha256.Sum256(raw)
		if original.ContentHash != hex.EncodeToString(h[:]) {
			t.Fatalf("content hash mismatch for %q", row.StableKey)
		}
	}
	if len(seen) != len(want) || len(sidecars) != len(want) {
		t.Fatalf("effective identity coverage rows=%d sidecars=%d want=%d", len(seen), len(sidecars), len(want))
	}
	// A new sibling and a permuted input leave every existing stable-key path intact.
	permuted := append([]Layer(nil), layers...)
	permuted[1].Std = overlay
	permuted[1].Std.Concepts = make(map[string]core.Concept, len(overlay.Concepts)+1)
	for k, v := range overlay.Concepts {
		permuted[1].Std.Concepts[k] = v
	}
	permuted[1].Std.Concepts["added.before"] = core.Concept{Title: "Added sibling"}
	permuted[1].Definitions = make(map[string]DefinitionSource, len(layers[1].Definitions)+1)
	for k, v := range layers[1].Definitions {
		permuted[1].Definitions[k] = v
	}
	permuted[1].Definitions["added.before"] = layers[1].Definitions["pilot.added"]
	augmented, _, err := pilotReviewProjection(permuted)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ids := map[string]string{}
	for _, row := range catalogkit.Rows(bundle) {
		ids[row.StableKey] = row.ID
	}
	for _, row := range catalogkit.Rows(augmented) {
		if before, ok := ids[row.StableKey]; ok && before != row.ID {
			t.Fatalf("insertion renamed %s: %s -> %s", row.StableKey, before, row.ID)
		}
	}
	// Exercise every CatalogOrigin field as well as the actual local origin.
	pinned := append([]Layer(nil), layers...)
	pinned[1].Origin = CatalogOrigin{
		SourceKind: "pinned-git", Repository: "https://example.invalid/catalog.git",
		Revision: "reviewed-revision", CatalogDigest: "reviewed-digest",
	}
	_, pinnedSidecars, err := pilotReviewProjection(pinned)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for key, side := range pinnedSidecars {
		wantOrigin := pinned[0].Origin
		if key == "pilot.added" {
			wantOrigin = pinned[1].Origin
		}
		if side.Origin != wantOrigin {
			t.Fatalf("catalog origin fields lost for %q: %+v", key, side.Origin)
		}
	}
}
